title: Rosemary L NDE 7108
content: My husband and I were visiting an ailing cousin in southern Maryland. All day, I felt stressed and began to have a headache. After we left my cousin's house to go to our hotel, we went to dinner and then I wanted to go to bed right away because I was so tired. In the morning, about 7:00 a.m., I awoke suddenly feeling very calm and with the feeling that I had just visited a very spiritual place. I had gone through a tunnel but the light at the end was not all that bright. I saw a lot of figures standing at the end of the tunnel. They seemed to be sepia- colored. They almost had the appearance of Monks. I felt great happiness and comfort and utter, complete love. I remember being so happy there and I did not want to leave. The most profound feeling of gentle beauty and love surrounded me but something was telling me it wasn't time for me to be there. That is when I woke up, much to my disappointment.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Uncertain. Heart attack. 'Extreme stress, headache, shortness of breath' 'Illness, trauma or other condition not considered life threatening' 'Extreme stress, headache, shortness of breath' I was told a week after the NDE that I had had a myocardial infarction. I had been under a lot of stress from visiting an antagonistic relative and wasn't feeling well before I went to sleep the night of the event. Because it was verified as a heart attack, I presume it was a life threatening event.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: No I lost awareness of my body
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal
elements.At what time during the experience were: Right before coming back, before waking up: I felt totally aware of a world full of love and happiness.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: My vision was misty; I could not make out the faces of the forms surrounding me. Unlike some people who have gone through this, I did not recognize any loved ones: only that there were 'spirits' or beings around me in this sepia-color.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I don't remember hearing as such; everything was more emotional, as if communicated non-verbally.
elements.The experience included: Tunnel | Presence of deceased persons | Darkness | A landscape or city | Strong emotional tone | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: Some unfamiliar and strange place Swirling colors, darkness mixed with light, dark tunnel with light at end.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I felt love, happiness, fulfillment, and enormous contentment.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.What is your religion now?: Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Secular unaffiliated
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin Beings around me had human shape but no identifiable features.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Uncertain Only insomuch that I felt one with the universe I was in at the time and it was a beautiful place to be. I know I did not want to return to my previous existence.
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: experience? God definitely exists Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes I am no longer afraid of death and feel certain I will meet up with my loved ones after I die.
elements.Did you believe in an afterlife prior to: I was uncertain if an afterlife exists
elements.Were you fearful living your life prior: Moderately fearful in living my earthly life
elements.Were you fearful living your life after: Slightly fearful in living my earthly life
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes Love is everywhere..we are love, we are made from love. When we die, love will be what waits for us.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: Moderate changes in my life Moderate changes in my life. No fear of dying or the afterlife.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Uncertain Uncertain I still seem to make the same mistakes with my life and relationships. Perhaps that is why I was sent back, because I have a lot more to learn in these areas.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Uncertain Uncertain I still seem to make the same mistakes with my life and relationships. Perhaps that is why I was sent back, because I have a lot more to learn in these areas. After the NDE
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience I feel as if this happened just yesterday.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: All of life is created from love. God is not a punisher and we are here to learn lessons. Evil will not be punished by God but lessons will be taught.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes Just what I read and heard about.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real I had no doubts as to the reality of my experience. I knew it to be true.
